reviews.reviewText: Paper bekar tha. Past files se kuch nahi aya. 1700 MCQs parhay thay, sirf 1 aya. Master lecture se 8% aya. Sara paper conceptual aur tricky tha. Handouts mein itna nahi parhaya jitna pooch liya.
Paper was very difficult and conceptual. Past files were not helpful. Questions were tricky and required deep understanding of handouts and lectures. Topics covered went beyond basic lecture content.
